ex.cn: 她毅然走过来，要我向她道歉。

senses.def: to walk through the streets in a large group in order to protest about sth
to force sb to walk somewhere with you
senses.chn: 使同行；强迫（某人）一起走

ex.en: The guards marched the prisoner away.
ex.cn: 卫兵押着囚犯离开了。

senses.def: to be ordered to leave a place, a job, etc.
to order sb to leave a place, their job, etc.
to behave in a different way from other people; to have different attitudes or ideas

ex.en: She was a gifted and original artist who marched to a different drummer.
ex.cn: 她有天赋，具独创性，是个与众不同的艺术家。

senses.def: to move on or pass quickly

ex.en: Time marches on and we still have not made a decision.
ex.cn: 时间过得飞快，而我们却还没有拿定主意。

senses.def: to march to a place to protest about sth or to attack it
senses.chn: 向…行进（以示抗议或进行攻击）

ex.en: Several thousand people marched on City Hall.
ex.cn: 数千人涌往市政厅进行抗议。

senses.def: an organized walk by many people from one place to another, in order to protest about sth, or to express their opinions

ex.en: protest marches
ex.cn: 抗议游行

ex.en: to go on a march
ex.cn: 进行示威游行

senses.def: an act of marching; a journey made by marching

ex.en: The army began their long march to the coast.
ex.cn: 部队开始了他们开往沿海地区的长途行军。

senses.def: the steady development or forward movement of sth

ex.en: the march of progress/technology/time
ex.cn: 平稳的进步；技术的稳步发展；时光的推移

senses.def: a piece of music written for marching to

ex.en: a funeral march
ex.cn: 葬礼进行曲

senses.def: marching somewhere
senses.chn: 在行军中；在行进中；在进展中

ex.en: The enemy are on the march.
ex.cn: 敌人正在行军途中。

senses.def: to gain an advantage over sb by doing sth before them
senses.chn: 抢先（某人）一步；抢得先机

example.en: Soldiers were marching up and down outside the government buildings.
example.cn: 士兵在政府大楼外面来回练习队列行进。

example.en: They marched 20 miles to reach the capital.
example.cn: 他们行进了 20 英里才到达首都。

senses.def: a person who is taking part in a march as a protest
senses.chn: 游行示威者；抗议游行者

senses.def: a group of musicians who play while they are marching
senses.chn: 行进乐队；边行走边演奏的乐队

senses.def: (in Northern Ireland) the time in July and August when Protestant groups march through the streets in memory of victories over Catholics in the 17th century
senses.chn: 游行季节（北爱尔兰新教徒为纪念 17 世纪战胜天主教徒而在七、八月份上街游行）

senses.def: a woman who has the rank of a marquess
the wife of a marquess
to move on or pass quickly

ex.en: Time marches on and we still have not made a decision.
ex.cn: 时间过得飞快，而我们却还没有拿定主意。

senses.def: a ceremony in which soldiers march past an important person, etc.
senses.chn: 分列式（军人列队通过检阅台）

senses.def: the day before the beginning of Lent, celebrated as a holiday in some countries, with music and dancing in the streets
senses.chn: 肥美的星期二，狂欢节（大斋期的前一天）

senses.def: a female horse or donkey
a discovery that seems interesting but is found to have no value
senses.chn: （看似有趣但）毫无价值的发现

senses.def: a very complicated situation
senses.chn: 复杂的形势；变幻莫测的局势

senses.def: a road, street or path

ex.en: Mahatma Gandhi Marg
ex.cn: 圣雄甘地路

ex.en: He trekked along the lonely Badrinath paidal marg.
ex.cn: 他沿着人迹罕至的伯德里纳特步行小道跋涉。

ex.en: The Bhatki marg (the path of devotion) teaches followers to forget the physical self in pursuit of the Lord.
ex.cn: 虔诚之路教导信徒在追随神时忘掉身体自我。

senses.def: a yellow substance like butter made from animal or vegetable fats, used in cooking or spread on bread, etc.
an alcoholic drink made by mixing fruit juice with tequila
senses.chn: 玛格丽特酒（用果汁与墨西哥龙舌兰酒调制而成）

senses.def: a town on the south-east coast of England
senses.chn: 马盖特（英格兰东南沿海城镇）

senses.def: the empty space at the side of a written or printed page

ex.en: the left-hand/right-hand margin
ex.cn: 左／右页边

ex.en: a narrow/wide margin
ex.cn: 窄／宽空白边

ex.en: notes scribbled in the margin
ex.cn: 随手写在页边上的笔记

senses.def: the amount of time, or number of votes, etc. by which sb wins sth
senses.chn: （获胜者在时间或票数上领先的）幅度，差额，差数

ex.en: He won by a narrow margin.
ex.cn: 他以微小的差额获胜。

ex.en: She beat the other runners by a margin of ten seconds.
ex.cn: 她以领先十秒的优势战胜了其他赛跑者。

senses.def: an extra amount of sth such as time, space, money, etc. that you include in order to make sure that sth is successful
senses.chn: 余地；备用的时间（或空间、金钱等）

ex.en: a safety margin
ex.cn: 安全距离

ex.en: The narrow gateway left me little margin for error as I reversed the car.
ex.cn: 门口狭窄，弄得我倒车时几乎不能出任何差错。

senses.def: the extreme edge or limit of a place

ex.en: the eastern margin of the Indian Ocean
ex.cn: 印度洋的东岸

senses.def: the part that is not included in the main part of a group or situation

ex.en: people living on the margins of society
ex.cn: 生活在社会边缘的人

senses.def: an amount that is added to a basic wage, paid for special skill or responsibility
senses.chn: （基本工资以外的）技术津贴，职务补贴

senses.def: small and not important
senses.chn: 小的；微不足道的；不重要的

ex.en: a marginal improvement in weather conditions
ex.cn: 天气条件的略微好转

ex.en: The story will only be of marginal interest to our readers.
ex.cn: 我们的读者对这则故事不会很感兴趣。

senses.def: not part of a main or important group or situation

ex.en: marginal groups in society
ex.cn: 社会中的非主流群体

senses.def: won or lost by a very small number of votes and therefore very important or interesting as an indication of public opinion
senses.chn: （议席或选区）边缘的（以微弱票数决定成败）

ex.en: a marginal seat/constituency
ex.cn: 边缘席位／选区

senses.def: written in the margin of a page

ex.en: marginal notes/comments
ex.cn: 页边的注解／评论

senses.def: that cannot produce enough good crops to make a profit
a seat in a parliament, on a local council, etc. that was won by a very small number of votes
senses.chn: （议会或地方委员会的）边缘席位

ex.en: a Labour marginal
ex.cn: 工党的边缘席位

senses.def: notes written in the margins of a book, etc.
facts or details that are not very important
senses.chn: 无足轻重的事情；细枝末节

senses.def: to make sb feel as if they are not important and cannot influence decisions or events; to put sb in a position in which they have no power
senses.chn: 使显得微不足道；使处于边缘；使无实权

senses.def: very slightly; not very much
senses.chn: 轻微地；很少地；微不足道地

ex.en: They now cost marginally more than they did last year.
ex.cn: 现在并不比去年贵多少。

senses.def: an amount that you allow when you calculate sth, for the possibility that a number is not completely accurate

ex.en: The survey has a margin of error of 2.5%.
ex.cn: 测量的误差幅度为 2.5%。

senses.def: a small white garden flower with a yellow centre
a musician who plays traditional Mexican music, usually as part of a small group that travels from place to place; the type of music played by these musicians
senses.chn: 马里亚奇音乐演奏者，墨西哥传统音乐演奏者（常为街头乐队成员）；马里亚奇音乐；墨西哥街头音乐

ex.en: a mariachi band
ex.cn: 马里亚奇乐队

senses.def: relating to the Virgin Mary in the Christian church
a type of farming in which fish or other sea animals and plants are bred or grown for food
an orange or yellow garden flower. There are several types of marigold.
a drug (illegal in many countries) made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which gives the person smoking it a feeling of being relaxed
a musical instrument like a xylophone
a specially designed harbour for small boats and yachts
a mixture of oil, wine, spices, etc., in which meat or fish is left before it is cooked in order to make it softer or to give it a particular flavour
if you marinate food or it marinates, you leave it in a marinade before cooking it
senses.chn: 腌，浸泡（食物）；（食物）腌，浸泡

senses.def: connected with the sea and the creatures and plants that live there

ex.en: marine life
ex.cn: 海洋生物

ex.en: a marine biologist (= a scientist who studies life in the sea)
ex.cn: 海洋生物学家

senses.def: connected with ships or trade at sea
senses.chn: 海船的；货船的；海上贸易的

senses.def: a soldier who is trained to serve on land or at sea, especially one in the US Marine Corps or the British Royal Marines
senses.chn: （尤指美国或英国皇家）海军陆战队士兵

senses.def: a sailor
a puppet whose arms, legs and head are moved by strings
connected with marriage or with the relationship between a husband and wife

ex.en: marital difficulties/breakdown
ex.cn: 婚姻纠葛／破裂

senses.def: the fact of whether you are single, married, etc.

ex.en: questions about age, sex and marital status
ex.cn: 关于年龄、性别、婚姻状况的问题

senses.def: connected with the sea or ships
senses.chn: 海的；海事的；海运的；船舶的

ex.en: a maritime museum
ex.cn: 海洋博物馆

senses.def: near the sea

ex.en: maritime Antarctica
ex.cn: 南极近海地区

senses.def: a plant with leaves that smell sweet and are used in cooking as a herb, often when dried
senses.chn: 牛至（叶子芳香，常在干后用作烹调辅料）

senses.def: to write or draw a symbol, line, etc. on sth in order to give information about it

ex.en: Items marked with an asterisk can be omitted.
ex.cn: 打星号的项目可以删去。

ex.en: Prices are marked on the goods.
ex.cn: 价格标在商品上。

ex.en: The teacher marked her absent (= made a mark by her name to show that she was absent).
ex.cn: 老师在她的名字旁做了个缺课的记号。

ex.en: Why have you marked this wrong?
ex.cn: 你为什么批这道题为错？

ex.en: Do not open any mail marked 'Confidential'.
ex.cn: 不要打开任何标有 “机密” 的邮件。

senses.def: to make a mark on sth in a way that spoils or damages it; to become spoilt or damaged in this way
senses.chn: 留下痕迹；弄污；使有污点

ex.en: A large purple scar marked his cheek.
ex.cn: 他的面颊上有一块大紫疤。

ex.en: The surfaces are made from a material that doesn't mark.
ex.cn: 这些台面是由不会留下污渍的材料做的。

senses.def: to show the position of sth

ex.en: The cross marks the spot where the body was found.
ex.cn: 十字记号标明了发现死尸的地点。

ex.en: The route has been marked in red.
ex.cn: 路线用红色标明了。

senses.def: to celebrate or officially remember an event that you consider to be important

ex.en: a ceremony to mark the 50th anniversary of the end of the war
ex.cn: 纪念战争结束 50 周年的庆典

senses.def: to be a sign that sth new is going to happen
senses.chn: 是…的迹象；成为…的征兆；表明

ex.en: This speech may mark a change in government policy.
ex.cn: 这篇演讲表明政府的政策可能会有变化。

ex.en: The agreement marks a new phase in international relations.
ex.cn: 这一协议标志着国际关系新时期的到来。

senses.def: to give marks to students' work
senses.chn: 给（学生作业）打分，评分，评成绩

ex.en: I hate marking exam papers.
ex.cn: 我讨厌阅卷。

ex.en: I spend at least six hours a week marking.
ex.cn: 我每周至少要花六个小时批改作业。

senses.def: to give sb/sth a particular quality or character

ex.en: a life marked by suffering
ex.cn: 痛苦的一生

ex.en: He was marked as an enemy of the poor.
ex.cn: 他被列为穷人的敌人。

senses.def: used to tell sb to pay careful attention to sth

ex.en: There'll be trouble over this, mark my words.
ex.cn: 记住我的话，这件事是会有麻烦的。

ex.en: You mark what I say, John.
ex.cn: 约翰，注意听着。

senses.def: to stay close to an opponent in order to prevent them from getting the ball

ex.en: Hughes was marking Taylor.
ex.cn: 休斯在钉防泰勒。

ex.en: Our defence had him closely marked.
ex.cn: 我方后卫已经紧紧地钉住了他。

senses.def: to pass the time while you wait for sth more interesting

ex.en: I'm just marking time in this job—I'm hoping to get into journalism.
ex.cn: 我干这件工作只是在等待时机，我希望能从事新闻工作。

senses.def: to make marching movements without moving forwards
used to remind sb of sth they should consider in a particular case
senses.chn: 无论如何；尽管如此；反正；然而

ex.en: She hasn't had much success yet. Mark you, she tries hard.
ex.cn: 她还没取得什么成功，可是她非常努力。

senses.def: to reduce the mark/grade given to sb in an exam, etc.

ex.en: She was marked down because of poor grammar.
ex.cn: 她因语法不好被扣了分。

senses.def: to recognize sb as a particular type
senses.chn: 将某人看作；认定某人为

ex.en: I hadn't got him marked down as a liberal.
ex.cn: 我当时还没有把他看作自由主义者。

senses.def: to reduce the price of sth

ex.en: All goods have been marked down by 15%.
ex.cn: 所有商品都打八五折。

senses.def: to make a note of sth for future use or action

ex.en: The factory is already marked down for demolition.
ex.cn: 这家工厂已登记在案，准备拆除。

senses.def: to make sb/sth seem different from other people or things
senses.chn: 使与众不同；使有别于其他人（或物）

ex.en: Each of London's districts had a distinct character that marked it off from its neighbours.
ex.cn: 伦敦的每个区都有鲜明的特征，与邻近地区不同。

senses.def: to separate sth by marking a line between it and sth else

ex.en: The playing area was marked off with a white line.
ex.cn: 运动场地用白线画了出来。

senses.def: to make people recognize sb as special in some way

ex.en: She was marked out for early promotion.
ex.cn: 她被选定要尽早得到擢升。

senses.def: to draw lines to show the edges of sth
senses.chn: 画出界限；画出边界；用线画出范围

ex.en: They marked out a tennis court on the lawn.
ex.cn: 他们在草坪上标出网球场。

senses.def: to increase the price of sth

ex.en: Share prices were marked up as soon as trading started.
ex.cn: 交易一开始，股票价格就涨上去了。

senses.def: to mark or correct a text, etc., for example for printing

ex.en: to mark up a manuscript
ex.cn: 审校手稿

senses.def: a small area of dirt, a spot or a cut on a surface that spoils its appearance

ex.en: The children left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
ex.cn: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污渍斑斑。

ex.en: a burn/scratch mark
ex.cn: 一块灼伤的／抓伤的疤痕

ex.en: Detectives found no marks on the body.
ex.cn: 侦探没有在尸体上发现任何痕迹。

ex.en: The kids left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
ex.cn: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污迹斑斑。

ex.en: blood stains
ex.cn: 血迹

ex.en: Her fingerprints were all over the gun.
ex.cn: 那支枪上布满了她的指纹。

senses.def: a noticeable spot or area of colour on the body of a person or an animal which helps you to recognize them
senses.chn: （人或动物身上有助于识别的）斑点，记号，色斑

ex.en: a horse with a white mark on its head
ex.cn: 头上有块白斑的马

ex.en: He was about six feet tall, with no distinguishing marks.
ex.cn: 他身高约六英尺，没什么特别的记号。

ex.en: a white dog with a black patch on its head
ex.cn: 头上有一块黑斑的白狗

ex.en: patches of dense fog
ex.cn: 团团浓雾

ex.en: The letters 'i' and 'j' have dots over them.
ex.cn: 字母 i 和 j 上面都有一点。

ex.en: The island is a small green dot on the map.
ex.cn: 这个岛在地图上是一个小绿点。

senses.def: a written or printed symbol that is used as a sign of sth, for example the quality of sth or who made or owns it
senses.chn: 符号；记号；（显示质量、制造者或所有者等的）标记

ex.en: punctuation marks
ex.cn: 标点符号

ex.en: Any piece of silver bearing his mark is extremely valuable.
ex.cn: 带有他的印记的每一件银器都极有价值。

ex.en: I put a mark in the margin to remind me to check the figure.
ex.cn: 我在页边做了个记号来提醒自己核对一下这个数字。

senses.def: a sign that a quality or feeling exists
senses.chn: （品质或情感的）标志，迹象，表示

ex.en: On the day of the funeral businesses remained closed as a mark of respect.
ex.cn: 葬礼那天，商户停业以示敬意。

ex.en: Such coolness under pressure is the mark of a champion.
ex.cn: 在压力下仍能这样保持冷静，这就是冠军相。

senses.def: a number or letter that is given to show the standard of sb's work or performance or is given to sb for answering sth correctly

ex.en: to get a good/poor mark in English
ex.cn: 英语得分高／低

ex.en: to give sb a high/low mark
ex.cn: 给某人高分／低分

ex.en: What's the pass mark (= the mark you need in order to pass)?
ex.cn: 合格分数是多少？

ex.en: I got full marks (= the highest mark possible) in the spelling test.
ex.cn: 我在拼写测验中得了个满分。

ex.en: 'You're wearing a tie!' ' Full marks for observation.'
ex.cn: “你打领带啦！” “你真眼尖，我给你打满分。”

senses.def: a level or point that sth reaches that is thought to be important

ex.en: Unemployment has passed the four million mark.
ex.cn: 失业人数已突破四百万大关。

ex.en: She was leading at the half-way mark.
ex.cn: 赛程到一半时是她领先。

senses.def: a particular type or model of a machine or vehicle

ex.en: the Mark II engine
ex.cn: II 型发动机

senses.def: a particular level of temperature in a gas oven

ex.en: Preheat the oven to gas Mark 6.
ex.cn: 将烤箱预热到 6 挡。

senses.def: a cross made on a document instead of a signature by sb who is not able to write their name
senses.chn: （文盲在文件上代替签名的）花押

senses.def: a target

ex.en: Of the blows delivered, barely half found their mark.
ex.cn: 仅有不到半数的出拳击中目标。

ex.en: to hit/miss the mark
ex.cn: 击中／错过目标

senses.def: to be fairly accurate in a guess, statement, etc.
senses.chn: （猜测、陈述等）接近准确，几乎无误

senses.def: not to be accurate in a guess, statement, etc.
senses.chn: （猜测、陈述等）不准确，相去甚远，离题

ex.en: No, you're way off the mark.
ex.cn: 不行，你根本没说到重点。

senses.def: to be accurate or correct

ex.en: That estimate was right on the mark.
ex.cn: 那个估计分毫不差。

senses.def: to start scoring, especially in cricket

ex.en: Stewart got off the mark with a four.
ex.cn: 斯图尔特以一记四分球开始得分。

senses.def: to succeed/fail in achieving or guessing sth
senses.chn: 达到／没有达到目的；猜测正确／错误

ex.en: He blushed furiously and Robyn knew she had hit the mark.
ex.cn: 他满脸通红，萝宾知道自己击中了要害。

senses.def: to have an effect on sth/sb, especially a bad one, that lasts for a long time
senses.chn: 留下久远的影响（尤指坏影响）

ex.en: Such a traumatic experience was bound to leave its mark on the children.
ex.cn: 这样的痛苦经历一定会长期对孩子们有影响。

senses.def: to become famous and successful in a particular area
not to feel as well or lively as usual
used to tell runners in a race to get ready and then to start
fast/slow in reacting to a situation
as good as it/they should be

ex.en: Your work isn't really up to the mark.
ex.cn: 你的工作没有真正达到要求。

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable
to say or do what sb in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.chn: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

ex.en: to toe the party line
ex.cn: 遵循党的路线

senses.def: not accurate

ex.en: Their predictions turned out to be wide of the mark.
ex.cn: 后来发现他们的预测结果太离谱了。

example.en: Items marked with an asterisk can be omitted.
example.cn: 打星号的项目可以删去。

example.en: Prices are marked on the goods.
example.cn: 价格标在商品上。

example.en: The teacher marked her absent (= made a mark by her name to show that she was absent).
example.cn: 老师在她的名字旁做了个缺课的记号。

example.en: a life marked by suffering
example.cn: 痛苦的一生

example.en: He was marked as an enemy of the poor.
example.cn: 他被列为穷人的敌人。

example.en: You mark what I say, John.
example.cn: 约翰，注意听着。

senses.def: a reduction in price
easy to see

ex.cn: batch processing 是什么意思？

ex.en: Does the name 'Jos Vos' mean anything to you (= do you know who he is)?
ex.cn: 你知道乔斯 · 沃斯是谁吗？

ex.en: The flashing light means (that) you must stop.
ex.cn: 闪烁的灯光表示你必须停下。

senses.def: to intend to say sth on a particular occasion

ex.en: What did he mean by that remark?
ex.cn: 他说那话是什么意思？

ex.en: 'Perhaps we should try another approach.' ' What do you mean? (= I don't understand what you are suggesting.) '
ex.cn: “也许我们应该试一试别的方法。” “你指的是什么方法？”

ex.en: What do you mean, you thought I wouldn't mind?(= of course I mind and I am very angry)
ex.cn: 你这是什么意思？你以为我不会在意吗？

ex.en: What she means is that there's no point in waiting here.
ex.cn: 她的意思是说在这儿等下去没什么意思。

ex.en: I always found him a little strange, if you know what I mean (= if you understand what I mean by 'strange').
ex.cn: 我总觉得他有点儿怪，如果你明白我这话是什么意思。

ex.en: I know what you mean (= I understand and feel sympathy). I hated learning to drive too.
ex.cn: 我明白你的意思。我也不愿意学开车。

senses.def: to have sth as a purpose or intention

ex.en: What did she mean by leaving so early (= why did she do it)?
ex.cn: 她为什么这么早就走了？

ex.en: Don't laugh! I mean it (= I am serious).
ex.cn: 别笑！我是认真的。

ex.en: He means trouble (= to cause trouble).
ex.cn: 他存心捣乱。

ex.en: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
ex.cn: 别不高兴，我肯定她的原意是要称赞你的。

ex.en: He means what he says (= is not joking, exaggerating, etc.).
ex.cn: 他说话是当真的。

ex.en: The chair was clearly meant for a child.
ex.cn: 这椅子显然是专为儿童设计的。

senses.def: to intend sb to be or do sth
senses.chn: 想要某人成为；想要某人去做

ex.en: I was never meant for the army (= did not have the qualities needed to become a soldier).
ex.cn: 我根本就不是块当兵的料。

ex.en: Duncan and Makiko were meant for each other (= are very suitable as partners).
ex.cn: 邓肯和真纪子真是天生的一对。

ex.en: His father meant him to be an engineer.
ex.cn: 他父亲想让他当工程师。

ex.en: She did everything to get the two of them together, but I guess it just wasn't meant to be.
ex.cn: 她极力撮合他们俩，但我觉得那根本不可能。

senses.def: to have sth as a result or a likely result

ex.en: Spending too much now will mean a shortage of cash next year.
ex.cn: 现在花销太多就意味着明年现金短缺。

ex.en: Do you have any idea what it means to be poor?
ex.cn: 你知不知道贫穷意味着什么？

ex.en: We'll have to be careful with money but that doesn't mean (that) we can't enjoy ourselves.
ex.cn: 我们必须精打细算，可也并不是说我们就不能享受生活。

ex.en: This new order will mean working overtime.
ex.cn: 这新订单一来，我们就得加班加点。

ex.en: The injury could mean him missing next week's game.
ex.cn: 这次受伤可能使他无法参加下周的比赛。

ex.en: I'll be there at five fifteen, I mean five fifty—ten to six.
ex.cn: 我会在 5 点 15 分到那儿，不，应该是 5 点 50 分，差 10 分钟 6 点。

senses.def: to be of value or importance to sb

ex.en: Your friendship means a great deal to me.
ex.cn: 你的友谊对我来说是很珍贵的。

ex.en: $20 means a lot (= represents a lot of money) when you live on $100 a week.
ex.cn: 当你每周就靠 100 美元维持生活时，20 美元可是个大数目。

ex.en: Money means nothing to him.
ex.cn: 金钱对于他来说毫无价值。

ex.en: Her children mean the world to her.
ex.cn: 她的孩子就是她的一切。

senses.def: to be generally considered to be sth

ex.en: This restaurant is meant to be excellent.
ex.cn: 都说这家饭店很棒。

senses.def: used to explain or correct what you have just said
senses.chn: （解释或更正刚说过的话）我是说，意思是说

ex.en: It was so boring—I mean, nothing happened for the first hour!
ex.cn: 真是无聊。我是说，一个小时都过去了，什么事儿都没发生！

ex.en: She's English—Scottish, I mean.
ex.cn: 她是英格兰人，不对，是苏格兰人。

senses.def: to be serious in your intentions

ex.en: He has the look of a man who means business.
ex.cn: 他看上去像是个说话算话的人。

senses.def: to not have any intention of hurting sb
senses.chn: 没有恶意；并非出于恶意

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying or to ask sb if they really mean what they say
senses.chn: （强调要说的话，或问对方是否真是这个意思）意思是说

ex.en: I mean to say, you should have known how he would react!
ex.cn: 我的意思是说，你本应料到他会作何反应！

ex.en: Do you mean to say you've lost it?
ex.cn: 你是说你把那东西给弄丢了？

senses.def: to have good intentions, although their effect may not be good
not willing to give or share things, especially money

ex.en: She's always been mean with money.
ex.cn: 她在花钱方面总是非常吝啬。

senses.def: unkind, for example by not letting sb have or do sth

ex.en: Don't be so mean to your little brother!
ex.cn: 别对你弟弟那么刻薄！

senses.def: likely to become angry or violent

ex.en: That's a mean-looking dog.
ex.cn: 那狗看上去很凶。

senses.def: very good and skilful

ex.en: He's a mean tennis player.
ex.cn: 他是一名出色的网球选手。

ex.en: She plays a mean game of chess.
ex.cn: 她的国际象棋下得很棒。

senses.def: average; between the highest and the lowest, etc.

ex.en: the mean temperature
ex.cn: 平均气温

senses.def: not very great

ex.en: This should be clear even to the meanest intelligence.
ex.cn: 就是对智力最平庸的人来说，这也应当是非常明了的。

senses.def: poor and dirty in appearance

ex.en: mean houses/streets
ex.cn: 脏乱的房屋／街道

senses.def: born into or coming from a low social class
senses.chn: 出身卑贱的；社会地位低下的

senses.def: used to say that sb is very good at doing sth

ex.en: His mother was a painter, and he's no mean artist himself.
ex.cn: 他的母亲是画家，他本人也是很出色的艺术家。

senses.def: a quality, condition, or way of doing sth that is in the middle of two extremes and better than either of them

ex.en: He needed to find a mean between frankness and rudeness.
ex.cn: 他需要在坦诚与唐突之间找到折中的方法。

senses.def: the value found by adding together all the numbers in a group, and dividing the total by the number of numbers
senses.chn: 算术平均；平均数；平均值

senses.def: a course of action that is not extreme

example.en: What does this sentence mean?
example.cn: 这个句子是什么意思？

example.en: Does the name 'Jos Vos' mean anything to you (= do you know who he is)?
example.cn: 你知道乔斯 · 沃斯是谁吗？

example.en: The flashing light means (that) you must stop.
example.cn: 闪烁的灯光表示你必须停下。

example.en: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
example.cn: 别不高兴，我肯定她的原意是要称赞你的。

example.en: He means what he says (= is not joking, exaggerating, etc.).
example.cn: 他说话是当真的。

example.en: The chair was clearly meant for a child.
example.cn: 这椅子显然是专为儿童设计的。

example.en: She means to succeed.
example.cn: 她一意求成。

example.en: I didn't mean you to read the letter.
example.cn: 我没打算让你看那封信。

example.en: I was never meant for the army (= did not have the qualities needed to become a soldier).
example.cn: 我根本就不是块当兵的料。

example.en: His father meant him to be an engineer.
example.cn: 他父亲想让他当工程师。

example.en: Do you have any idea what it means to be poor?
example.cn: 你知不知道贫穷意味着什么？

example.en: This new order will mean working overtime.
example.cn: 这新订单一来，我们就得加班加点。

example.en: The injury could mean him missing next week's game.
example.cn: 这次受伤可能使他无法参加下周的比赛。

senses.def: to be serious in your intentions

ex.en: He has the look of a man who means business.
ex.cn: 他看上去像是个说话算话的人。

senses.def: to curve a lot rather than being in a straight line

ex.en: The stream meanders slowly down to the sea.
ex.cn: 这条小河弯弯曲曲缓慢地流向大海。

senses.def: to walk slowly and change direction often, especially without a particular aim
to develop slowly and change subject often, in a way that makes it boring or difficult to understand
senses.chn: （乏味地、令人费解地）漫谈，闲聊

senses.def: a course that does not follow a straight line

ex.en: the meanderings of a river/path
ex.cn: 曲折蜿蜒的一条河／小路

senses.def: walking or talking without any particular aim

ex.en: his philosophical meanderings
ex.cn: 他的哲学漫谈

senses.def: used when you realize that you have said sth that you should not have said
senses.chn: 我真多嘴；真不该说出来

senses.def: used especially by children to describe an unkind person who will not give them what they want
the thing or idea that a sound, word, sign, etc. represents
senses.chn: （声音、文字、信号等传递的）意义，意思

ex.en: What's the meaning of this word?
ex.cn: 这个单词的意思是什么？

ex.en: Words often have several meanings.
ex.cn: 单词往往有若干个意思。

ex.en: 'Honesty'? He doesn't know the meaning of the word!
ex.cn: “诚实”？他不明白这个词是什么意思！

senses.def: the things or ideas that sb wishes to communicate to you by what they say or do

ex.en: I don't quite get your meaning (= understand what you mean to say).
ex.cn: 我不太明白你要说的意思。

ex.en: What's the meaning of this? I explicitly told you not to leave the room.
ex.cn: 这是什么意思？我明确地告诉过你不要离开这个房间。

senses.def: the real importance of a feeling or experience

ex.en: With Anna he learned the meaning of love.
ex.cn: 通过与安娜相处，他明白了爱意味着什么。

senses.def: the ideas that a writer, artist, etc. wishes to communicate through a book, painting, etc.
senses.chn: （作家或艺术家要表达的）意义，含意，思想

ex.en: several layers of meaning
ex.cn: 若干层意义

ex.en: There are, of course, deeper meanings in the poem.
ex.cn: 当然，这首诗里还有更深层的含意。

senses.def: the quality or sense of purpose that makes you feel that your life is valuable

ex.en: Her life seemed to have lost all meaning.
ex.cn: 她的生活似乎已毫无价值。

ex.en: Having a child gave new meaning to their lives.
ex.cn: 有了孩子使他们的生活有了新的方向。

senses.def: serious and important

ex.en: a meaningful relationship/discussion/experience
ex.cn: 重要的关系／讨论／经历

senses.def: intended to communicate or express sth to sb, without any words being spoken
senses.chn: 意味深长的；意在言外的

ex.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
ex.cn: 她意味深长地看了我一眼。

senses.def: having a meaning that is easy to understand
senses.chn: 意义明显的；易于理解的

ex.en: These statistics are not very meaningful.
ex.cn: 这些统计数字说明不了什么问题。

senses.def: without any purpose or reason and therefore not worth doing or having
senses.chn: 毫无意义的；毫无目的的；无价值的

ex.en: a meaningless existence
ex.cn: 毫无意义的存在

ex.en: We fill up our lives with meaningless tasks.
ex.cn: 我们终日忙忙碌碌，过得毫无意义。

senses.def: not considered important

ex.en: Fines are meaningless to a huge company like that.
ex.cn: 对于这样一家大公司，罚金根本算不了什么。

senses.def: not having a meaning that is easy to understand

ex.en: To me that painting is completely meaningless.
ex.cn: 对我来说，这幅油画晦涩难懂。

senses.def: an action, an object or a system by which a result is achieved; a way of achieving or doing sth

ex.en: Television is an effective means of communication.
ex.cn: 电视是一种有效的传播手段。

ex.en: Is there any means of contacting him?
ex.cn: 有没有什么办法和他取得联系？

ex.en: Have you any means of identification?
ex.cn: 你有没有任何身份证件？

ex.en: We needed to get to London but we had no means of transport.
ex.cn: 我们需要去伦敦，但却没有任何交通工具。

senses.def: the money that a person has

ex.en: People should pay according to their means.
ex.cn: 人们应该按照各自的负担能力来消费。

ex.en: He doesn't have the means to support a wife and child.
ex.cn: 他无钱养活妻小。

ex.en: Private school fees are beyond the means of most people (= more than they can afford).
ex.cn: 私立学校的费用是大多数人无力支付的。

ex.en: Are the monthly repayments within your means (= can you afford them)?
ex.cn: 这样按月还钱，你负担得了吗？

ex.en: Try to live within your means (= not spend more money than you have).
ex.cn: 要尽可能量入为出。

ex.en: a man of means (= a rich man)
ex.cn: 有钱人

senses.def: used to say that you are very willing for sb to have sth or do sth

ex.en: 'Do you mind if I have a look?' 'By all means.'
ex.cn: “我看一眼行吗？” “当然可以。”

senses.def: with the help of sth

ex.en: The load was lifted by means of a crane.
ex.cn: 重物是用起重机吊起来的。

senses.def: not at all

ex.en: She is by no means an inexperienced teacher.
ex.cn: 她绝不是个毫无经验的教师。

ex.en: We haven't won yet, not by any means.
ex.cn: 我们离成功还远着呢。

senses.def: a thing or action that is not interesting or important in itself but is a way of achieving sth else
senses.chn: （本身并不重要或有趣的）达到目的的手段

ex.en: He doesn't particularly like the work but he sees it as a means to an end.
ex.cn: 他不怎么喜欢这项工作，只是把它看作达到目的的手段而已。

senses.def: bad or unfair methods of doing sth are acceptable if the result of that action is good or positive
senses.chn: 只要目的正当，可以不择手段

senses.def: using dishonest methods if honest ones do not work
the methods and materials available for doing sth
senses.chn: （做某事现有的）方法和资源，手段和财力

ex.en: ways and means of raising money
ex.cn: 筹资办法

senses.def: an official check of sb's wealth or income in order to decide if they are poor enough to receive money from the government, etc. for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 收入调查，经济情况调查（以确定是否可领取政府补贴等）

senses.def: paid to sb according to the results of a means test
senses.chn: 按收入调查结果支付的

ex.en: means-tested benefits
ex.cn: 按经济情况调查结果支付的补助

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: I'm changing my email address but for the meantime you can use the old one.
ex.cn: 我要更换电邮地址，不过那个旧的暂时也还可以用。

senses.def: in the period of time between two times or two events

ex.en: My first novel was rejected by six publishers. In the meantime I had written a play.
ex.cn: 我的第一部小说遭到六家出版商的拒绝。其间我又完成了一部戏剧。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying or to ask sb if they really mean what they say
senses.chn: （强调要说的话，或问对方是否真是这个意思）意思是说

ex.en: I mean to say, you should have known how he would react!
ex.cn: 我的意思是说，你本应料到他会作何反应！

ex.en: Do you mean to say you've lost it?
ex.cn: 你是说你把那东西给弄丢了？

senses.def: to have good intentions, although their effect may not be good
while sth else is happening

ex.en: Bob spent fifteen months alone on his yacht. Ann, meanwhile, took care of the children on her own.
ex.cn: 鲍勃独自在他的游艇上待了十五个月。在这段时间，安一个人照顾孩子。

senses.def: in the period of time between two times or two events

ex.en: The doctor will see you again next week. Meanwhile, you must rest as much as possible.
ex.cn: 医生下周还会给你看病。在此期间，你一定要尽可能多休息。

senses.def: used to compare two aspects of a situation

ex.en: Stress can be extremely damaging to your health. Exercise, meanwhile, can reduce its effects.
ex.cn: 压力可能严重损害你的健康，锻炼则可以减轻这些损害。

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

ex.en: We need some new curtains, but these will do for the meanwhile.
ex.cn: 我们需要一些新的窗帘，但这些暂时还可以用。

senses.def: in the period of time between two times or two events

ex.en: I hope to go to medical school eventually. In the meanwhile, I am going to study chemistry.
ex.cn: 我希望最终能上医学院。这期间我打算学化学。

senses.def: an infectious disease, especially of children, that causes fever and small red spots that cover the whole body
very small in size or quantity; not enough

ex.en: I get a measly £4 an hour.
ex.cn: 我每小时只拿少得可怜的 4 英镑。

senses.def: that can be measured
large enough to be noticed or to have a clear and noticeable effect

ex.en: measurable improvements
ex.cn: 显著的改进

senses.def: to find the size, quantity, etc. of sth in standard units

ex.en: A ship's speed is measured in knots.
ex.cn: 船速以节测量。

ex.en: a device that measures the level of radiation in the atmosphere
ex.cn: 测量大气中辐射强度的仪器

ex.en: measuring equipment/instruments
ex.cn: 测量装备／仪器

ex.en: He's gone to be measured for a new suit.
ex.cn: 他去量尺寸做新套装去了。

ex.en: A dipstick is used to measure how much oil is left in an engine.
ex.cn: 量油尺是用来探查引擎中的剩余油量的。

senses.def: to be a particular size, length, amount, etc.

ex.en: The main bedroom measures 12ft by 15ft.
ex.cn: 主卧室宽 12 英尺，长 15 英尺。

ex.en: The pond measures about 2 metres across.
ex.cn: 这个池塘宽约 2 米。

senses.def: to judge the importance, value or effect of sth
senses.chn: 估量，判定（重要性、价值或影响等）

ex.en: It is difficult to measure the success of the campaign at this stage.
ex.cn: 在现阶段还难以估量这场运动的成败。

senses.def: to compare sb/sth with sb/sth

ex.en: The figures are not very good when measured against those of our competitors.
ex.cn: 和我们的竞争者相比，我们的数字并不乐观。

senses.def: to take the amount of sth that you need from a larger amount

ex.en: He measured out a cup of milk and added it to the mixture.
ex.cn: 他倒了一杯牛奶，掺了进去。

senses.def: to measure sb/sth

ex.en: We spent the morning measuring up and deciding where the furniture would go.
ex.cn: 我们花了一上午量来量去，决定家具怎么摆。

senses.def: to be as good, successful, etc. as expected or needed
senses.chn: 达到预期的要求；符合标准

ex.en: Last year's intake just didn't measure up.
ex.cn: 去年纳入的人数没有达到预期的要求。

ex.en: The job failed to measure up to her expectations.
ex.cn: 这项工作没有满足她的期望。

senses.def: an official action that is done in order to achieve a particular aim

ex.en: safety/security/austerity measures
ex.cn: 安全／保安／紧缩措施

ex.en: a temporary/an emergency measure
ex.cn: 临时／紧急措施

ex.en: We must take preventive measures to reduce crime in the area.
ex.cn: 我们必须采取预防措施来减少这个地区的犯罪。

ex.en: The government is introducing tougher measures to combat crime.
ex.cn: 政府正在引入更强硬的手段来打击犯罪。

ex.en: measures against racism
ex.cn: 反种族主义措施

ex.en: Police in riot gear were in attendance as a precautionary measure.
ex.cn: 身着防暴服的警察到场戒备。

senses.def: a unit used for stating the size, quantity or degree of sth; a system or a scale of these units

ex.en: weights and measures
ex.cn: 度量衡

ex.en: The Richter Scale is a measure of ground motion.
ex.cn: 里氏震级是测量地动的单位。

ex.en: liquid/dry measure
ex.cn: 液量；干量

ex.en: Which measure of weight do pharmacists use?
ex.cn: 药剂师使用什么剂量单位？

senses.def: a standard quantity

ex.en: a generous measure of whisky
ex.cn: 比标准量稍多一点的威士忌

senses.def: a particular amount of sth, especially a fairly large amount

ex.en: A measure of technical knowledge is desirable in this job.
ex.cn: 做这项工作最好多懂一些技术知识。

ex.en: She achieved some measure of success with her first book.
ex.cn: 她出第一部书就获得了相当的成功。

senses.def: an instrument such as a stick, a long tape or a container that is marked with standard units and is used for measuring
a sign of the size or the strength of sth

ex.en: Sending flowers is a measure of how much you care.
ex.cn: 送花能表明你有多关心。

senses.def: a way of judging or measuring sth

ex.en: an accurate measure of ability
ex.cn: 能力的准确评判

ex.en: Is this test a good measure of reading comprehension?
ex.cn: 这种测试是判断阅读理解力的好方法吗？

senses.def: a written suggestion, especially one for a new law made by the lawmakers of a state
senses.chn: （尤指州立法者的）提案，法案，议案

ex.en: a motion to refer the measure to another committee
ex.cn: 将提案提交给另一个委员会的动议

ex.en: a ballot measure (= a change in the law that voters decide on)
ex.cn: 投票表决的法案

senses.def: one of the short sections of equal length that a piece of music is divided into, and the notes that are in it
very much

ex.en: He irritated me beyond measure.
ex.cn: 他使我非常生气。

senses.def: as an extra amount of sth in addition to what has already been done or given
senses.chn: 作为额外增添；外加的项目

a unit for measuring the volume of liquids and gases; a 1 000th of a litre
a unit for measuring length; a 1 000th of a metre

senses.chn: 女帽制造商；制造（或销售）女帽的人

hats sold in shops/stores
moving around in a large mass

ex.cn: 我不得不在涌动的人潮中挤出一条路来。

ex.cn: 它一定值一百万。

ex.cn: 四百万人受影响。

senses.def: a very large amount

ex.cn: 我还有很多很多的事情要做。

ex.cn: 那里人山人海。

senses.def: a person who has a million pounds, dollars, etc.; a very rich person

ex.en: an oil millionaire
ex.cn: 石油行业的百万富翁

ex.cn: 她是个亿万富婆。

ex.cn: 十分富有的商人

each of one million equal parts of sth

a 1 000th of a second

ex.cn: 我稍稍犹豫了一下。

senses.chn: （尤指旧时用于推动磨坊水车的）磨坊水池

ex.en: My debts are a millstone around my neck.
ex.cn: 债务成了我难以摆脱的负担。

a large wheel that is turned by water and that makes the machinery of a mill work

ex.cn: 演出包括舞蹈、音乐和哑剧。

ex.cn: 每一名参加者都得用哑剧动作表现出一部电影、戏剧或一本书的标题。

ex.en: He mimed climbing a mountain.
ex.cn: 他用哑剧形式表示爬山。

senses.chn: （按照播放录音等）模拟歌唱；假唱

ex.en: The band was miming to a backing tape.
ex.cn: 乐队在跟着伴奏带假唱。

example.en: Each player has to mime the title of a movie, play or book.
example.cn: 每一名参加者都得用哑剧动作表现出一部电影、戏剧或一本书的标题。

example.en: He mimed climbing a mountain.
example.cn: 他用哑剧形式表示爬山。

senses.def: the way in which the real world and human behaviour is represented in art or literature
senses.chn: （文学艺术创作中的）模拟，模仿

senses.def: the fact of a particular social group changing their behaviour by copying the behaviour of another social group
the fact of a plant or animal developing a similar appearance to another plant or animal.
the fact of a set of symptoms suggesting that sb has a particular disease, when in fact that person has a different disease or none
copying the behaviour or appearance of sb/sth else
to copy the way sb speaks, moves, behaves, etc., especially in order to make other people laugh
senses.chn: 模仿（某人的言行举止）；（尤指）做滑稽模仿

ex.en: She's always mimicking the teachers.
ex.cn: 她总喜欢模仿老师的言谈举止。

ex.en: He mimicked her southern accent.
ex.cn: 他滑稽地模仿她的南方口音。

senses.def: to look or behave like sth else

ex.en: The robot was programmed to mimic a series of human movements.
ex.cn: 机器人按程序设计可模仿人的一系列动作。

senses.def: a person or an animal that can copy the voice, movements, etc. of others
the action or skill of being able to copy the voice, movements, etc. of others

ex.en: a talent for mimicry
ex.cn: 模仿的天才

senses.def: a tropical bush or tree with balls of yellow flowers and leaves that are sensitive to touch and light
senses.chn: 含羞草；银莉；白粉金合欢

senses.def: an alcoholic drink made by mixing sparkling white wine (= with bubbles) with orange juice

senses.def: a form of Chinese spoken mainly in SE China

senses.chn: 宣礼塔（常为清真寺的一部分）

senses.chn: 用绞肉机绞（食物，尤指肉）

ex.cn: 绞碎的牛肉

senses.def: to walk with quick short steps, in a way that is not natural

ex.cn: 他迈着碎步过来招待我们。

senses.def: to say sth in a direct way even though it might offend other people
meat, especially beef, that has been finely chopped in a special machine
senses.chn: 绞碎的肉，肉末（尤指牛肉）

ex.en: a pound of mince
ex.cn: 一磅碎肉

senses.def: a mixture of dried fruit, spices, etc. used especially for making pies
senses.chn: 百果馅（干水果、香料等做成，尤用于做馅饼）

a small round pie filled with mincemeat, traditionally eaten at Christmas, especially in Britain
senses.chn: （尤指英国传统上于圣诞节食用的）百果馅饼

senses.def: a machine for cutting food, especially meat, into very small pieces
senses.chn: 食物绞碎机；（尤指）绞肉机

senses.def: very delicate, and not natural
senses.chn: 故作斯文的；装模作样的；忸怩作态的

ex.en: short mincing steps
ex.cn: 忸怩作态的小碎步

senses.def: the part of a person that makes them able to be aware of things, to think and to feel

ex.en: the conscious/subconscious mind
ex.cn: 意识；潜意识

ex.en: There were all kinds of thoughts running through my mind.
ex.cn: 各种念头在我脑海中闪过。

ex.en: There was no doubt in his mind that he'd get the job.
ex.cn: 他毫不怀疑自己能得到这份工作。

ex.en: 'Drugs' are associated in most people's minds with drug abuse.
ex.cn: 大多数人把 drugs 与嗜毒联想在一起。

ex.en: She was in a disturbed state of mind.
ex.cn: 她的脑子里一片混乱。

ex.en: I could not have complete peace of mind before they returned.
ex.cn: 他们不回来，我心里就不踏实。

senses.def: your ability to think and reason; your intelligence; the particular way that sb thinks
senses.chn: 思考能力；智慧；思维方式

ex.en: to have a brilliant/good/keen mind
ex.cn: 有非凡的智力／良好的思考能力／敏锐的头脑

ex.en: a creative/an evil/a suspicious mind
ex.cn: 富创意的头脑；邪恶的用心；怀疑的心态

ex.en: She had a lively and enquiring mind.
ex.cn: 她思想活跃，善于探索。

ex.en: His mind is as sharp as ever.
ex.cn: 他思维敏锐，一如既往。

ex.en: I've no idea how her mind works!
ex.cn: 我真不知道她是怎么想的！

ex.en: He had the body of a man and the mind of a child.
ex.cn: 他四肢发达，头脑简单。

senses.def: a person who is very intelligent

ex.en: She was one of the greatest minds of her generation.
ex.cn: 她是她那一代人中最聪慧的人之一。

senses.def: your thoughts, interest, etc.

ex.en: Keep your mind on your work!
ex.cn: 专心干你的活吧！

ex.en: Her mind is completely occupied by the new baby.
ex.cn: 她一心扑在刚出世的宝宝身上。

ex.en: The lecture dragged on and my mind wandered.
ex.cn: 演讲没完没了，我都心不在焉。

ex.en: He gave his mind to the arrangements for the next day.
ex.cn: 他认真考虑第二天的安排。

ex.en: As for avoiding you, nothing could be further from my mind (= I was not thinking of it at all).
ex.cn: 至于说躲避你，我根本就没有这样的想法。

senses.def: your ability to remember things

ex.en: When I saw the exam questions my mind just went blank (= I couldn't remember anything).
ex.cn: 我看到考题时，脑子里一下子变得一片空白。

ex.en: Sorry—your name has gone right out of my mind.
ex.cn: 对不起，我完全想不起你的名字了。

senses.def: to be sth that only exists in sb's imagination

ex.en: These problems are all in your mind, you know.
ex.cn: 你知道，这些问题都只是你的凭空想象而已。

senses.def: to remember sb/sth; to remember or consider that…
senses.chn: 将…记在心中；记住；考虑到

senses.def: to be extremely bored, etc.
senses.chn: 感到非常无聊（或害怕等）；烂醉如泥；晕头转向

senses.def: to be unable to think or behave in a normal way; to become crazy

ex.en: You're lending them money? You must be out of your tiny mind!
ex.cn: 你要把钱借给他们？你真是疯到家了。

ex.en: I thought I'd go mad if I stayed any longer.
ex.cn: 我觉得再待久一点我就会发疯。

ex.en: A crazy old woman rented the upstairs room.
ex.cn: 一个疯老太婆租了楼上那个房间。

ex.en: That noise is driving me nuts!
ex.cn: 那噪音吵得我要疯了！

ex.en: You guys are nuts!
ex.cn: 你们这些家伙全疯了！

ex.en: Her mum's completely batty.
ex.cn: 她妈妈完全是疯疯癫癫的。

senses.def: to be unable to decide what you think about sb/sth, or whether to do sth or not

ex.en: I was in two minds about the book (= I didn't know if I liked it or not).
ex.cn: 我说不清我是否喜欢这本书。

ex.en: She's in two minds about accepting his invitation.
ex.cn: 是否接受他的邀请，她犹豫不决。

senses.def: to have the same opinion about sb/sth
senses.chn: 对…意见一致；对…看法相同

senses.def: to be extremely worried, etc.
senses.chn: 极度焦虑（或愁苦等）；忧心忡忡

senses.def: to remember sb/sth

ex.en: She couldn't call to mind where she had seen him before.
ex.cn: 她想不起来曾在哪里见过他。

senses.def: to remind you of sb/sth

ex.en: The painting brings to mind some of Picasso's early works.
ex.cn: 这幅油画使人想起了毕加索早期的一些作品。

senses.def: if sth comes/springs to mind, you suddenly remember or think of it

ex.en: When discussing influential modern artists, three names immediately come to mind.
ex.cn: 讨论现代有影响力的艺术家时，有三个名字一下子出现在脑海中。

senses.def: used to say that you think you will do sth, although you are not sure
senses.chn: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

ex.en: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
ex.cn: 明天我可能会和你一起去。

senses.def: used to say that you disapprove of what sb has done and should do sth about it, although you probably will not
senses.chn: （表明有心做某事，但未必采取行动）

ex.en: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
ex.cn: 我真想写信给你父母，告诉他们这件事。

senses.def: to be thinking of sb/sth, especially for a particular job, etc.
senses.chn: 心中有适当人选（或想做的事等）

ex.en: Do you have anyone in mind for this job?
ex.cn: 你有没有想到什么人可以做这项工作？

ex.en: Watching TV all evening wasn't exactly what I had in mind!
ex.cn: 我才不愿整个晚上看电视呢！

senses.def: to intend to do sth
to have your own opinion and make your own decisions without being influenced by other people

ex.en: She has a mind of her own and isn't afraid to say what she thinks.
ex.cn: 她有主见，并且敢于表达自己的观点。

ex.en: My computer seems to have a mind of its own!
ex.cn: 我的电脑好像也有它自己的想法！

senses.def: to become mentally ill
to decide sth

ex.en: They're both beautiful—I can't make up my mind.
ex.cn: 两个都很漂亮，我难以决定。

ex.en: Have you made up your minds where to go for your honeymoon?
ex.cn: 你们决定好到哪里去度蜜月了吗？

ex.en: You'll never persuade him to stay—his mind's made up (= he has definitely decided to go).
ex.cn: 你根本无法劝他留下来，他已经拿定主意了。

ex.en: Come on—it's make your mind up time!
ex.cn: 嗨，你该作出决定了！

senses.def: the use of the power of your mind to deal with physical problems
senses.chn: 精神胜过物质（用精神力量处理物质问题）

senses.def: your imagination

ex.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
ex.cn: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: if sb/sth is on your mind, you are thinking and worrying about them/it a lot

ex.en: You've been on my mind all day.
ex.cn: 我一整天都在为你担心。

ex.en: Don't bother your father tonight—he's got a lot on his mind.
ex.cn: 今晚就别打扰你父亲了，他的烦心事儿已经够多了。

senses.def: to stop thinking about sb/sth; to deliberately forget sb/sth

ex.en: I just can't get her out of my mind.
ex.cn: 我就是忘不掉她。

senses.def: to make sb think of sb/sth; to remind sb of sb/sth
to do or say sth to make sb stop worrying about sth
to decide you want to achieve sth and give this all your attention

ex.en: She could have been a brilliant pianist if she'd put her mind to it.
ex.cn: 如果她专心致志，坚持到底，她本可以成为一名杰出的钢琴家。

senses.def: to make you forget about sth unpleasant for a short time
senses.chn: 转移一下注意力；暂时将不好的事忘记

senses.def: in my opinion

ex.en: It was a ridiculous thing to do, to my mind.
ex.cn: 依我看，这样做是很荒唐的。

senses.def: if a thought, etc. is at the back of your mind, you are aware of it but it is not what you are mainly thinking about
to think very hard about or put a lot of effort into one particular thing
to produce a very strong pleasant or shocking feeling

ex.en: Wait till you hear this. It'll blow your mind.
ex.cn: 等着听听这个吧。它会让你大感意外的。

senses.def: if sth boggles the mind or the mind boggles at it, it is so unusual that people find it hard to imagine or accept
senses.chn: 使人无法想象；使人难以接受

ex.en: The vastness of space really boggles the mind.
ex.cn: 太空之辽阔的确使人难以想象。

ex.en: 'He says he's married to his cats!' 'The mind boggles!'
ex.cn: “他说他和他的那些猫结婚了！” “难以置信！”

senses.def: to make yourself think about sth that happened in the past

ex.en: I want you to cast your minds back to the first time you met.
ex.cn: 我要你们回忆初次见面的情景。

senses.def: to change a decision or an opinion

ex.en: Nothing will make me change my mind.
ex.cn: 什么都不能让我改变主意。

senses.def: an act of changing what you think about a situation, etc.
to refuse to think about sth as a possibility
senses.chn: 对…拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

senses.def: to come into your mind

ex.en: It never crossed my mind that she might lose (= I was sure that she would win).
ex.cn: 我从来没想过她会失败。

senses.def: if sth is etched on your memory, you remember it because it has made a strong impression on you
senses.chn: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

senses.def: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about sth
to have very firm ideas about what you want to do
senses.chn: 知道自己想做什么；有主见

senses.def: a close understanding between people with similar ideas, especially when they meet to do sth or meet for the first time
senses.chn: 彼此间的深刻理解（尤指初会时就意见一致）

senses.def: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.chn: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

senses.def: to become or make sb aware of new ideas or experiences
to tell sb that you disapprove of their behaviour or are angry with them
senses.chn: 表明对某人的行为不满；向某人表示恼火

senses.def: to make sb think and worry about it all the time
to try to forget about sth unpleasant
senses.chn: 刻意忘掉（不愉快的事）；把…丢到脑后

ex.en: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.
ex.cn: 我尽量把这个念头忘掉。

senses.def: (not) mentally normal

ex.en: I thought I'd go mad if I stayed any longer.
ex.cn: 我觉得再待久一点我就会发疯。

ex.en: A crazy old woman rented the upstairs room.
ex.cn: 一个疯老太婆租了楼上那个房间。

ex.en: That noise is driving me nuts!
ex.cn: 那噪音吵得我要疯了！

ex.en: You guys are nuts!
ex.cn: 你们这些家伙全疯了！

ex.en: Her mum's completely batty.
ex.cn: 她妈妈完全是疯疯癫癫的。

ex.en: She was out of her mind with grief.
ex.cn: 她悲痛得精神失常了。

senses.def: to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily
used to say sb will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
if sth slips your mind, you forget it or forget to do it
to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.chn: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

senses.def: to be remembered for a long time

ex.en: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind.
ex.cn: 他有一幅画我记得特别清楚。

senses.def: a particular way of thinking about things
not responsible for your actions because of a mental illness
senses.chn: 精神失常，神志不清（无须对自己的行为负责）

senses.def: to be upset, annoyed or worried by sth
senses.chn: 对（某事）烦恼，苦恼，焦虑；介意

ex.en: I don't mind the cold—it's the rain I don't like.
ex.cn: 冷我不在乎，我是讨厌下雨。

ex.en: I hope you don't mind the noise.
ex.cn: 希望你不介意这声音。

ex.en: He wouldn't have minded so much if she'd told him the truth.
ex.cn: 如果她把真相告诉他，他就不会那么焦虑了。

ex.en: Did she mind about not getting the job?
ex.cn: 她没得到这份工作是不是很介意？

ex.en: Did she mind not getting the job?
ex.cn: 她没得到这份工作是不是很介意？

ex.en: Do your parents mind you leaving home?
ex.cn: 你父母舍得你离开家吗？

senses.def: used to ask for permission to do sth, or to ask sb in a polite way to do sth
senses.chn: （请求允许或客气地请人做事）介意

ex.en: Do you mind if I open the window?
ex.cn: 我开开窗户好吗？

ex.en: Are you married, if you don't mind me asking?
ex.cn: 如果你不介意，请问你结婚了吗？

ex.en: Are you married, if you don't mind my asking?
ex.cn: 如果你不介意，请问你结婚了吗？

ex.en: Would you mind explaining that again, please?
ex.cn: 请你再解释一遍行吗？

ex.en: Do you mind driving? I'm feeling pretty tired.
ex.cn: 你来开车好吗？我太累了。

ex.en: Could you possibly help me?
ex.cn: 请问您能帮帮我吗？

senses.def: to not care or not be concerned about sth

ex.en: 'Would you like tea or coffee?' 'I don't mind—either's fine.'
ex.cn: “你要茶还是要咖啡？” “无所谓，什么都行。”

ex.en: Don't mind her—she didn't mean what she said.
ex.cn: 别理她，她只是随便说说。

ex.en: Don't mind me (= don't let me disturb you) —I'll just sit here quietly.
ex.cn: 别管我，我就在这儿静静地坐坐。

senses.def: to be willing to do sth

ex.en: I don't mind helping if you can't find anyone else.
ex.cn: 如果你找不到别人，我乐意帮忙。

ex.en: Could you possibly help me?
ex.cn: 请问您能帮帮我吗？

ex.en: I wonder if you could give me a hand?
ex.cn: 不知道您能否帮我一个忙？

ex.en: Would you mind opening the door for me?
ex.cn: 请你帮我开开门好吗？

ex.en: I wonder if you'd mind taking a picture of us?
ex.cn: 不知道您是否愿意给我们拍张照片？

ex.en: Could I ask you to keep an eye on my luggage for a moment?
ex.cn: 请你帮我照看一下行李好吗？

senses.def: used to tell sb to be careful about sth or warn them about a danger

ex.en: Mind (= Don't fall on) that step!
ex.cn: 注意台阶！

ex.en: Mind your head!(= for example, be careful you don't hit it on a low ceiling)
ex.cn: 小心，别碰着头！

ex.en: Mind your language!(= don't speak in a rude or offensive way)
ex.cn: 说话注意点！

ex.en: Mind how you go!(= often used when you say goodbye to sb)
ex.cn: 您走好！

ex.en: Mind where you're treading!
ex.cn: 当心脚下！

ex.en: Mind you don't cut yourself—that knife's very sharp.
ex.cn: 小心别伤着，这刀子快得很。

senses.def: to pay attention to what sb says, and obey them

ex.en: And the moral of the story is: always mind your mother!
ex.cn: 这个故事的寓意是：一定要听母亲的话！

senses.def: to take care of sb/sth

ex.en: Who's minding the children this evening?
ex.cn: 今天晚上谁看孩子？

ex.en: Could you mind my bags for a moment?
ex.cn: 你能不能照看一下我的袋子？

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed about sth that sb has just said or done

ex.en: Do you mind? I was here before you.
ex.cn: 你别这样好不好？我比你先到。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying, especially when you are talking about sth that may be embarrassing for you
senses.chn: 我不在乎承认（或告诉等）

ex.en: I was scared, I don't mind telling you!
ex.cn: 说真的，我吓坏了。

senses.def: used to say politely that you would like sth you have been offered
senses.chn: （礼貌地表示愿意接受）好的，可以

ex.en: 'Cup of tea, Brian?' 'I don't mind if I do.'
ex.cn: “喝杯茶吧，布赖恩？” “好的。”

senses.def: used to check that sb does not object to sth you want to do, or to ask sb politely to do sth
senses.chn: （想要确保对方不反对，或客气地请人做事）你不会在意吧，你若不介意的话

ex.en: I'd like to ask you a few questions, if you don't mind.
ex.cn: 如果你不介意的话，我想问你几个问题。

ex.en: Can you read that form carefully, if you wouldn't mind, and then sign it.
ex.cn: 请您仔细看一看那份表格，然后签个字，行吗？

senses.def: used to show that you object to sth that sb has said or done
senses.chn: （表示反对某人所做的事或所说的话）如蒙你不在意

ex.en: I give the orders around here, if you don't mind.
ex.cn: 不好意思，在这里我说了算。

senses.def: used to refuse an offer politely

ex.en: 'Will you come with us tonight?' 'I won't, if you don't mind—I've got a lot of work to do.'
ex.cn: “你今晚和我们一起去吗？” “对不起，我不去了，我有好多事要做。”

senses.def: used when you are going to criticize sb or say sth that might upset them
senses.chn: （批评等之前说）你不会在意我这么说吧

ex.en: That colour doesn't really suit you, if you don't mind my saying so.
ex.cn: 这颜色并不十分适合你。我这么说，你不会介意吧。

senses.def: used to say politely that you would very much like sth/to do sth

ex.en: I wouldn't mind a cup of coffee, if it's no trouble.
ex.cn: 要是不麻烦的话，我很想来杯咖啡。

ex.en: I wouldn't mind having his money!
ex.cn: 我愿意接受他的钱！

senses.def: to think about your own affairs and not ask questions about or try to get involved in other people's lives

ex.en: 'What are you reading?' 'Mind your own business!'
ex.cn: “你在读什么呢？” “少管闲事！”

ex.en: I was just sitting there, minding my own business, when a man started shouting at me.
ex.cn: 我就坐在那儿，也没招谁惹谁，忽然有个男人对我大喊大叫。

senses.def: to be in charge of sth for a short time while sb is away

ex.en: Who's minding the shop while the boss is abroad?
ex.cn: 老板出国期间由谁代管？

senses.def: used to add sth to what you have just said, especially sth that makes it less strong
senses.chn: （对刚说过的话加以补充，尤使语气减弱）请注意，告诉你吧

ex.en: I've heard they're getting divorced. Mind you, I'm not surprised—they were always arguing.
ex.cn: 听说他们要离婚了。告诉你吧，我并不感到意外，因为他们总是争吵。

senses.def: to behave in the most polite way you can
used to tell sb not to worry or be upset

ex.en: Have you broken it? Never mind, we can buy another one.
ex.cn: 你把它打碎了？没关系，我们可以再买一个。

senses.def: used to suggest that sth is not important
senses.chn: （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

ex.en: This isn't where I intended to take you—but never mind, it's just as good.
ex.cn: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what is true about the first thing you have said is even more true about the second

ex.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
ex.cn: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to tell sb they shouldn't think about sth or do sth because it is not as important as sth else, or because you will do it
senses.chn: （因为某事是次要的，或因为你要做某事）别想它，先别管

ex.en: Never mind your car—what about the damage to my fence?
ex.cn: 先别管你的车，我的围栏撞坏了，怎么办？

ex.en: Never mind washing the dishes—I'll do them later.
ex.cn: 别管洗碟子的事了，等一下我会洗。

senses.def: used to tell sb not to ask about sth because you are not going to tell them
senses.chn: （表明不会告诉对方）不要问，别管

ex.en: 'Who told you about it?' 'Never you mind!'
ex.cn: “谁告诉你这事儿的？” “别问了！”

ex.en: Never you mind how I found out—it's true, isn't it?
ex.cn: 别问我是怎么知道的。这是真的，对不对？

senses.def: to be careful about what you say in order not to upset or offend sb

ex.en: Watch your language, young man!
ex.cn: 年轻人，注意你的措辞！

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way
used to tell sb to move so that you can pass

ex.en: Mind out—you're in the way there!
ex.cn: 请让一让，你挡着路啦！

senses.def: used to warn sb of danger

ex.en: Have some of my plum jam—but mind out for the stones.
ex.cn: 尝尝我的李子酱，但得当心有核儿。

example.en: I don't mind the cold—it's the rain I don't like.
example.cn: 冷我不在乎，我是讨厌下雨。

example.en: Did she mind about not getting the job?
example.cn: 她没得到这份工作是不是很介意？

example.en: Did she mind not getting the job?
example.cn: 她没得到这份工作是不是很介意？

example.en: Do your parents mind you leaving home?
example.cn: 你父母舍得你离开家吗？

example.en: She never minded how hot it was.
example.cn: 她从不在乎天气有多热。

example.en: He minded that he hadn't been asked.
example.cn: 没被邀请，他很是耿耿于怀。

example.en: Are you married, if you don't mind me asking?
example.cn: 如果你不介意，请问你结婚了吗？

example.en: Don't mind her—she didn't mean what she said.
example.cn: 别理她，她只是随便说说。

example.en: Mind (= Don't fall on) that step!
example.cn: 注意台阶！

example.en: Mind how you go!(= often used when you say goodbye to sb)
example.cn: 您走好！

example.en: Mind you don't cut yourself—that knife's very sharp.
example.cn: 小心别伤着，这刀子快得很。

senses.def: having a strong effect on your mind
very exciting, impressive or surprising
senses.chn: 非常令人兴奋的；给人印象极深的；非常令人吃惊的

ex.en: Watching your baby being born is a mind-blowing experience.
ex.cn: 看你的孩子出生是一次非常难忘的经历。

senses.def: very difficult to imagine or to understand; extremely surprising
senses.chn: 难以想象的；难以理解的；令人惊愕的

ex.en: a problem of mind-boggling complexity
ex.cn: 复杂得难以想象的问题

senses.def: having the way of thinking, the attitude or the type of character mentioned

ex.en: a fair-minded employer
ex.cn: 公正的雇主

ex.en: high-minded principles
ex.cn: 高尚的原则

ex.en: I appeal to all like-minded people to support me.
ex.cn: 我呼吁所有志同道合的人来支持我。

senses.def: having the type of mind that is interested in or able to understand the areas mentioned
senses.chn: 对…有兴趣（或能理解）；有…头脑

ex.en: I'm not very politically minded.
ex.cn: 我对政治不怎么感兴趣。

senses.def: interested in or enthusiastic about the thing mentioned
senses.chn: 对…感兴趣的；对…有热情的

ex.en: a reform-minded government
ex.cn: 热衷于改革的政府

senses.def: wishing or intending to do sth

ex.en: She was minded to accept their offer.
ex.cn: 她有意接受他们的提议。

senses.def: a person whose job is to take care of and protect another person

ex.en: a star surrounded by her minders
ex.cn: 被保镖簇拥着的女明星

senses.def: remembering sb/sth and considering them or it when you do sth

ex.en: mindful of our responsibilities
ex.cn: 意识到我们的责任

ex.en: Mindful of the danger of tropical storms, I decided not to go out.
ex.cn: 想到热带风暴的危险，我决定不出门。

senses.def: something that you do or say in order to make sb feel less confident, especially to gain an advantage for yourself
senses.chn: （尤指为了压倒对方而展开的）心理游戏，心理战术

senses.def: done or acting without thought and for no particular reason or purpose
senses.chn: 没头脑的；无谓的；盲目的

ex.en: mindless violence
ex.cn: 无谓的暴力

ex.en: mindless vandals
ex.cn: 盲目破坏公物者

senses.def: not needing thought or intelligence

ex.en: a mindless and repetitive task
ex.cn: 机械重复的工作

senses.def: not remembering sb/sth and not considering them or it when you do sth

ex.en: We explored the whole town, mindless of the cold and rain.
ex.cn: 我们不顾寒冷和下雨，在整个城市到处转。

senses.def: very boring
senses.chn: 非常乏味的；令人厌烦的

ex.en: mind-numbing conversation
ex.cn: 很无聊的谈话

senses.def: used to tell sb to move so that you can pass

ex.en: Mind out—you're in the way there!
ex.cn: 请让一让，你挡着路啦！

senses.def: the use of the power of your mind to deal with physical problems
senses.chn: 精神胜过物质（用精神力量处理物质问题）

senses.def: a person who knows what sb else is thinking without being told
a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that sb has and that are often difficult to change

ex.en: a conservative mindset
ex.cn: 保守的思维模式

ex.en: the mindset of the computer generation
ex.cn: 计算机时代的思维倾向

senses.def: the extent of knowledge of a company or product among consumers, compared with their knowledge of others of the same type
senses.chn: 心理份额，心理占有率（指公司或产品相对于同类为消费者所了解的程度）

senses.def: to be in charge of sth for a short time while sb is away

ex.en: Who's minding the shop while the boss is abroad?
ex.cn: 老板出国期间由谁代管？

senses.def: used to add sth to what you have just said, especially sth that makes it less strong
senses.chn: （对刚说过的话加以补充，尤使语气减弱）请注意，告诉你吧

ex.en: I've heard they're getting divorced. Mind you, I'm not surprised—they were always arguing.
ex.cn: 听说他们要离婚了。告诉你吧，我并不感到意外，因为他们总是争吵。

senses.def: to think about your own affairs and not ask questions about or try to get involved in other people's lives

ex.en: 'What are you reading?' 'Mind your own business!'
ex.cn: “你在读什么呢？” “少管闲事！”

ex.en: I was just sitting there, minding my own business, when a man started shouting at me.
ex.cn: 我就坐在那儿，也没招谁惹谁，忽然有个男人对我大喊大叫。

senses.def: to behave in the most polite way you can
of or belonging to the person writing or speaking

ex.en: That's mine.
ex.cn: 这是我的。

ex.en: He's a friend of mine (= one of my friends).
ex.cn: 他是我的一个朋友。

ex.en: She wanted one like mine (= like I have).
ex.cn: 她想要一个和我的一样的。

senses.def: my home

ex.en: Let's go back to mine after the show.
ex.cn: 看完表演后我们去我家吧。

senses.def: a deep hole or holes under the ground where minerals such as coal, gold, etc. are dug

ex.en: a copper/diamond mine
ex.cn: 铜矿；钻石矿

senses.def: a type of bomb that is hidden under the ground or in the sea and that explodes when sb/sth touches it
a person, book, etc. that can give you a lot of information on a particular subject
to dig holes in the ground in order to find and obtain coal, diamonds, etc.

ex.en: The area has been mined for slate for centuries.
ex.cn: 这个地区开采板岩有数百年了。

ex.en: They were mining for gold.
ex.cn: 他们在开采黄金。

senses.def: to place mines below the surface of an area of land or water; to destroy a vehicle with mines
senses.chn: 埋雷于；布雷；用雷炸毁（车辆）

ex.en: The coastal route had been mined.
ex.cn: 沿海道路上布了地雷。

ex.en: The UN convoy was mined on its way to the border.
ex.cn: 联合国车队在驶往边界的途中触雷被炸。

example.en: The area has been mined for slate for centuries.
example.cn: 这个地区开采板岩有数百年了。

example.en: They were mining for gold.
example.cn: 他们在开采黄金。

senses.def: a piece of equipment for finding mines(= bombs that explode when they are touched)
an area of land or water where mines(= bombs that explode when they are touched) have been hidden
a situation that contains hidden dangers or difficulties
senses.chn: 危机四伏的局面；充满潜在危险的形势

ex.en: a legal minefield
ex.cn: 法律上有潜在危险的局面

ex.en: Tax can be a minefield for the unwary.
ex.cn: 粗心大意的人在纳税方面很容易出错。

senses.def: a military ship for finding and destroying mines(= bombs that explode when they are touched)
a person who works in a mine taking out coal, gold, diamonds, etc.

a substance that is naturally present in the earth and is not formed from animal or vegetable matter, for example gold and salt. Some minerals are also present in food and drink and in the human body and are essential for good health.

ex.en: mineral deposits/extraction
ex.cn: 矿藏；矿物开采

ex.en: the recommended intake of vitamins and minerals
ex.cn: 维生素和矿物质的建议摄入量

senses.def: a sweet drink in various flavours that has bubbles of gas in it and does not contain alcohol

ex.en: Soft drinks and minerals sold here.
ex.cn: 此处销售各种软饮料和汽水。

senses.def: a scientist who studies mineralogy
the scientific study of minerals
a liquid with no colour and no smell that comes from petroleum and is used in medicines and cosmetics
senses.chn: 矿物油（用于制造药品和化妆品）

senses.def: water from a spring in the ground that contains mineral salts or gases

ex.en: A glass of mineral water, please.
ex.cn: 请给我来杯矿泉水。

senses.def: a glass or bottle of mineral water
a deep narrow hole that goes down to a mine
an Italian soup containing small pieces of vegetables and pasta
senses.chn: （含蔬菜和意大利面的）意大利浓菜汤

senses.def: a ship used for finding and clearing away mines(= bombs that explode when they are touched)
a person who works in a mine
the female sex organs or pubic hair
a person who is not attractive
very bad, unpleasant or ugly
senses.chn: 非常糟糕的；令人不快的；丑陋的

senses.def: to combine or make one thing combine with another

ex.en: The sounds of laughter and singing mingled in the evening air.
ex.cn: 笑声和歌声交织在夜空中。

ex.en: Her tears mingled with the blood on her face.
ex.cn: 她的泪水和脸上的血混在了一起。

ex.en: He felt a kind of happiness mingled with regret.
ex.cn: 他感到既高兴又遗憾。

ex.en: The flowers mingle together to form a blaze of colour.
ex.cn: 鲜花锦簇，色彩绚烂。

ex.en: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl.
ex.cn: 把所有的配料放在碗里搅和一下。

ex.en: Oil and water do not mix.
ex.cn: 油和水不相融。

senses.def: to move among people and talk to them, especially at a social event
senses.chn: （尤指在社交场所）相交往，混杂其中

ex.en: The princess was not recognized and mingled freely with the crowds.
ex.cn: 公主没有人认出，随意混杂在人群之中。

ex.en: If you'll excuse me, I must go and mingle (= talk to other guests).
ex.cn: 对不起，我得去和其他客人聊聊。

example.en: Her tears mingled with the blood on her face.
example.cn: 她的泪水和脸上的血混在了一起。

example.en: The flowers mingle together to form a blaze of colour.
example.cn: 鲜花锦簇，色彩绚烂。

senses.def: small, not generous
small

ex.en: mini-break (= a short holiday/vacation)
ex.cn: 短假

ex.en: minigolf
ex.cn: 迷你高尔夫球运动

senses.def: very small; much smaller than usual

ex.en: miniature roses
ex.cn: 小玫瑰花

ex.en: a rare breed of miniature horses
ex.cn: 一种罕见的小矮马

ex.en: It looks like a miniature version of James Bond's car.
ex.cn: 它看上去像一辆小型的詹姆斯 · 邦德的汽车。

senses.def: a very small detailed painting, often of a person
a very small copy or model of sth; a very small version of sth

ex.en: brandy miniatures (= very small bottles)
ex.cn: 小瓶白兰地

senses.def: on a very small scale

ex.en: a doll's house with everything in miniature
ex.cn: 样样东西都很小的玩具小屋

ex.en: Through play, children act out in miniature the dramas of adult life.
ex.cn: 通过游戏，孩子们演出了成年人生活的缩影。

senses.def: a painter who paints small works of art
to make a much smaller version of sth
a small fridge/refrigerator in a hotel room, with drinks in it for guests to use
senses.chn: 迷你吧（旅馆房间里放有饮料的小冰箱）

senses.def: any small animal that does not have a backbone

ex.en: minibeasts such as worms, snails, centipedes and spiders
ex.cn: 蠕虫、蜗牛、蜈蚣以及蜘蛛等小型无脊椎动物

senses.def: a small vehicle with seats for about twelve people
a taxi that you have to order by telephone and cannot stop in the street
senses.chn: （须电话预订而不能自由揽客的）出租汽车

senses.def: a video camera that is small enough to hold in one hand
senses.chn: 小型摄像机；迷你摄像机

senses.def: a disc like a small CD that can record and play sound or data
a very short dress
senses.chn: 迷你连衣裙；超短连衣裙

senses.def: a type of golf in which people go around a small course hitting a ball through or over little tunnels, hills, bridges and other objects
a note that lasts twice as long as a crotchet/ quarter note
very small in size or amount; as small as possible

ex.en: The work was carried out at minimal cost.
ex.cn: 这项工作是以最少的开销完成的。

ex.en: There's only a minimal amount of risk involved.
ex.cn: 所冒的风险极小。

ex.en: The damage to the car was minimal.
ex.cn: 汽车受到的损坏很小。

senses.def: an artist, a musician, etc. who uses very simple ideas or a very small number of simple elements in their work
senses.chn: 极简抽象派艺术家；简约主义者

senses.def: a pair of words, sounds, etc. which are distinguished from each other by only one feature, for example pin and bin
senses.chn: 最小对立体（只在一个特征上有区别的一对词、发音等，如 pin 和 bin）

senses.def: a small shop/store that sells food, newspapers, etc. and stays open very late
to reduce sth, especially sth bad, to the lowest possible level

ex.en: Good hygiene helps to minimize the risk of infection.
ex.cn: 保持清洁有助于最大限度地减少感染的危险。

senses.def: to try to make sth seem less important than it really is
senses.chn: 降低；贬低；使显得不重要

ex.en: He always tried to minimize his own faults, while exaggerating those of others.
ex.cn: 他总是试图对自己的错误轻描淡写，对别人的错误夸大其词。

senses.def: to make sth small, especially on a computer screen
senses.chn: （尤指在计算机屏幕上）使最小化

ex.en: Minimize any windows you have open.
ex.cn: 把你打开的所有窗口最小化。

senses.def: a small motorcycle about 60cm high that people ride for fun and in races, but not on public roads
senses.chn: 迷你摩托车（用于游戏和比赛，但不上路）

senses.def: the smallest that is possible or allowed; extremely small
senses.chn: 最低的；最小的；最低限度的

ex.en: a minimum charge/price
ex.cn: 最低收费／价格

ex.en: the minimum age for retirement
ex.cn: 退休的最低年龄

ex.en: The work was done with the minimum amount of effort.
ex.cn: 做这项工作没费什么劲。

senses.def: the smallest or lowest amount that is possible, required or recorded
senses.chn: 最小值；最少量；最低限度

ex.en: Costs should be kept to a minimum.
ex.cn: 成本应保持在最低限度。

ex.en: The class needs a minimum of six students to continue.

ex.cn: 他满脸通红，萝宾知道自己击中了要害。

ex.cn: 我要再认真看一遍这份表格，免得漏掉什么。

ex.cn: 我当然要来，我可不想错失好玩的机会。

ex.cn: 就这些，谢谢，李普曼小姐。

ex.cn: 布赖顿小姐

ex.cn: 就这些吗，小姐？

ex.cn: 他攻进两球，另有两球也险些破门。

ex.cn: 我今晚不想打羽毛球了。

example.cn: 她差一点没打着他。

example.cn: 她走了以后，人们会非常思念她的。

senses.def: a book that contains the prayers etc. that are used at Mass in the Roman Catholic Church

ex.cn: 导弹基地／发射场

ex.cn: 我一直没找到丢了的那件。

ex.cn: 我的手套已经丢了很久了。

ex.cn: 两份档案不见了。

ex.cn: 他们仍然希望找到他们丢失的儿子。

senses.chn: 被去除的；丢失的；被损毁的；缺少的

ex.cn: 这本书缺了两页。

ex.en: He didn't notice there was anything missing from his room until later on.
ex.cn: 后来他才注意到他的屋里丢了东西。

ex.cn: 有报道说他失踪了，并推定已经丧生。

ex.cn: 许多士兵都被列在战斗失踪人员名单上。

senses.def: not included, often when it should have been
senses.chn: 缺少的；未被包括在内的

ex.cn: 有几名候选人没有出现在名单中。

ex.cn: 赴华贸易使命

ex.en: a fact-finding mission
ex.cn: 核查事实的工作

ex.cn: 帮助无家可归的难民的慈善工作

ex.cn: 在柏林的英国使团团长

ex.cn: 在非洲的天主教传教士

senses.def: a building or group of buildings used by a Christian mission

ex.cn: 她以帮助无家可归者为己任。

senses.def: an important job that is done by a soldier, group of soldiers, etc.

ex.cn: 这支空军中队执行一项侦察任务。

senses.def: a flight into space

ex.en: a US space mission
ex.cn: 美国的太空飞行

ex.en: mission control (= the people on earth who control and communicate with the people on the mission )
ex.cn: 太空飞行的地面指挥人员

senses.def: a task or journey that is very difficult and takes a long time to complete
senses.chn: （极其艰巨且需长时间才能完成的）任务，旅行

ex.cn: 一路上要经历艰辛才能到达那里。

senses.def: used when you have successfully completed what you have had to do

senses.chn: 作艰苦的长途旅行（尤指去许多地方）

ex.cn: 我们跑遍了所有的酒吧才找到他。

senses.def: used when you have successfully completed what you have had to do
a person who is sent to a foreign country to teach people about Christianity

ex.en: Baptist missionaries
ex.cn: 浸礼会传教士

ex.en: missionary work
ex.cn: 传教士的工作

ex.en: She spoke about her new project with missionary zeal (= with great enthusiasm).
ex.cn: 她以极大的热忱谈论自己的新项目。

senses.def: a letter, especially a long or an official one

senses.chn: 密苏里（美国中西部的州，首府杰斐逊城，最大城市堪萨斯城）

senses.def: to say sth in a way that is not clear or not accurate

ex.en: He was confused and may have misspoken to reporters.
ex.cn: 他被弄糊涂了，可能对记者没说清楚。

ex.en: Let me rephrase, I think I misspoke myself.
ex.cn: 我换个说法吧，我刚才可能没说清楚。

ex.en: a misspoken word
ex.cn: 一处口误

example.cn: 他被弄糊涂了，可能对记者没说清楚。

example.en: Let me rephrase, I think I misspoke myself.
example.cn: 我换个说法吧，我刚才可能没说清楚。

example.en: a misspoken word
example.cn: 一处口误

senses.def: to spell a word wrongly

senses.chn: 挥霍，浪费，滥用（时间或金钱）

ex.cn: 他开玩笑地说擅长打牌表明他虚度了青春年华。

to be unable to take advantage of sth because you are too late

ex.en: If you don't buy now, you may find that you've missed the boat.
ex.cn: 你如果现在不买，你会错失良机的。

ex.cn: 你老婆怎么样？

ex.cn: 我女友不喜欢玩电脑游戏。

ex.cn: 不许那样对我讲话，小丫头！

ex.cn: 我的判断没错的话，你的电脑需要更换一个新的硬盘驱动器。

ex.cn: 这些小山笼罩在薄雾之中。

ex.cn: 清晨弥漫着的水汽很快会散尽。

ex.cn: 她泪眼模糊，凝视着面前的景象。

ex.en: The windows were misted up with condensation.
ex.cn: 窗户上凝满了水珠，一片模糊。

ex.cn: 他从寒冷的户外进来，眼镜马上蒙上了一层雾气。

ex.cn: 她听着演讲，眼中噙满了泪水。

ex.cn: 犯错误很容易。

ex.cn: 这封信是给别人的，一定是搞错了。

ex.cn: 没关系，我们都会犯错。

ex.cn: 你得从所犯错误中吸取教训。

ex.cn: 我一生中最大的错误就是那么年轻就离开了学校。

ex.cn: 这是学英语的人常犯的错误。

ex.en: The waiter made a mistake (in) adding up the bill.
ex.cn: 服务员结账时算错了账。

ex.cn: 我承认我误解了他的意图。

ex.cn: 她的声音里流露出怨恨的情绪，这是很明显的。

ex.en: I mistook her offer as a threat.
ex.cn: 我把她的好心错看成威胁了。

ex.en: Sorry—I mistook what you said.
ex.cn: 不好意思，我误解你的话了。

example.cn: 我承认我误解了他的意图。

example.en: I mistook her offer as a threat.
example.cn: 我把她的好心错看成威胁了。

ex.cn: 你对简的看法完全错了。

ex.cn: 要是我没太弄错的话，那边那个就是保罗的妻子。

ex.cn: 我误以为可以相信她，就把我的秘密告诉了她。

ex.cn: 他像是被人认错了而遭到枪击的。

ex.cn: 求求你，先生，能把球还给我们吗？

ex.cn: 这匹马起跳的时机完全不对，把骑手摔了下来。

ex.cn: 她对陌生人的猜疑极深。

ex.cn: 薄雾弥漫的早晨

ex.cn: 别误解我的意思，我对你所做的一切都很感激。
