example.en: He muttered that he was sorry.
example.cn: 他轻声嘀咕了一声对不起。

senses.def: complaints that you express privately rather than openly

ex.en: There have been mutterings about his leadership.
ex.cn: 底下对他的领导一直怨声不断。

senses.def: words that you speak very quietly to yourself
meat from a fully grown sheep
used to describe a woman who is trying to look younger than she really is, especially by wearing clothes that are designed for young people
hair at the sides of a man's face which is grown so that it is very wide and round in shape at the bottom
senses.chn: 羊排络腮胡（长于脸颊两边，底部呈宽圆形）

senses.def: used to describe a woman who is trying to look younger than she really is, especially by wearing clothes that are designed for young people
used to describe feelings that two or more people have for each other equally, or actions that affect two or more people equally

ex.en: mutual respect/understanding
ex.cn: 相互的尊敬／理解

ex.en: mutual support/aid
ex.cn: 相互的支持／帮助

ex.en: I don't like her, and I think the feeling is mutual (= she doesn't like me either).
ex.cn: 我不喜欢她，我觉得她也不喜欢我。

senses.def: shared by two or more people

ex.en: We met at the home of a mutual friend.
ex.cn: 我们在彼此都认识的朋友家中会面。

ex.en: They soon discovered a mutual interest in music.
ex.cn: 他们很快发现对音乐有着共同的兴趣。

senses.def: a company that offers a service to people by investing their money in various different businesses
senses.chn: 共同基金，单位信托投资公司（代客户进行不同组合的投资）

senses.def: felt or done equally by two or more people

ex.en: a mutually beneficial/supportive relationship
ex.cn: 互惠／互助的关系

ex.en: Can we find a mutually convenient time to meet?
ex.cn: 我们可以找个双方都适当的时间会面吗？

ex.en: The two views are not mutually exclusive (= both can be true at the same time).
ex.cn: 这两种观点并不互相排斥。

senses.def: the nose and mouth of an animal, especially a dog or a horse
a device made of leather or plastic that you put over the nose and mouth of an animal, especially a dog, to prevent it from biting people
the open end of a gun, where the bullets come out
to put a muzzle over a dog's head to prevent it from biting people
to prevent sb from expressing their opinions in public as they want to

ex.en: They accused the government of muzzling the press.
ex.cn: 他们指责政府压制新闻自由。

senses.def: unable to think in a clear way

ex.en: a muzzy head
ex.cn: 稀里糊涂的大脑

ex.en: Those drugs made me feel muzzy.
ex.cn: 那些药使我昏昏欲睡。

senses.def: not clear

ex.en: a muzzy voice
ex.cn: 模糊不清的声音

ex.en: muzzy plans
ex.cn: 过于笼统的计划

senses.def: (used before the name of a ship) motor vessel

ex.en: the MV Puma
ex.cn: 美洲狮号机动船

senses.def: most valuable player (the best player in a team)
senses.chn: 最优秀选手；最有价值球员

ex.en: He has just earned his fourth MVP award this season.
ex.cn: 这个赛季他刚获得了他的第四个 “最有价值球员奖”。

senses.def: medium wave
megawatt
Member of the Welsh Assembly
used to represent the sound that some people make when they kiss sb on the cheek
a teacher
a title or form of address for sb who is respected as a teacher

ex.en: Mwalimu Julius Nyerere
ex.cn: 朱利叶斯 · 尼雷尔导师

senses.def: an ordinary citizen; a member of the public

ex.en: The common mwananchi is demanding change.
ex.cn: 普通民众要求变革。

senses.def: of or belonging to the speaker or writer

ex.en: Where's my passport?
ex.cn: 我的护照在哪儿？

ex.en: My feet are cold.
ex.cn: 我的脚冷。

senses.def: used in exclamations to express surprise, etc.

ex.en: My goodness! Look at the time!
ex.cn: 天哪！看看几点了！

senses.def: used when addressing sb, to show affection

ex.en: my dear/darling/love
ex.cn: 亲爱的；我的宝贝儿／心肝儿

senses.def: used when addressing sb that you consider to have a lower status than you

ex.en: My dear girl, you're wrong.
ex.cn: 我亲爱的姑娘，你错了。

senses.def: pain in a muscle
a country in South East Asia
used when you are admitting that sth is your fault or that you have made a mistake

ex.en: I'm sorry—my bad.
ex.cn: 对不起，我错了。

senses.def: the scientific study of fungi
a mixture of proteins and fats that surrounds many nerve cells, increasing the speed at which they send signals
senses.chn: 髓磷脂，髓鞘质（由脂质、蛋白质组成，包绕在神经细胞轴突上）

senses.def: a type of cancer found as a tumour inside the bone
used to emphasize what you are saying when you are surprised, shocked or annoyed
senses.chn: （惊讶、震惊或烦恼时说）天哪，啊哟，主啊

ex.en: God, what a stupid thing to do!
ex.cn: 天啊，这事干得太蠢了！

senses.def: used to express surprise
used to say that you will not repeat sb's secret to other people
senses.chn: （表示不会说出某人的秘密）我把嘴封住，我绝口不提

senses.def: a SE Asian bird with dark feathers, that can copy human speech
senses.chn: （东南亚一种能模仿人说话的）黑羽鸟

senses.def: (especially in emails, comments on social networking websites, etc.) mind your own business (think about your own affairs and do not ask questions about or try to get involved in other people's lives)
senses.chn: 不关你的事，少管闲事（全写为 mind your own business，尤用于电邮、社交网站评论等）

senses.def: the inability to see things clearly when they are far away
the inability to see what the results of a particular action or decision will be; the inability to think about anything outside your own situation
used as a polite way of replying when sb thanks you for doing sth, to show that you were happy to do it
senses.chn: （对别人表示感谢的一种礼貌回答）不客气，很乐意效劳

senses.def: an extremely large number of sth

ex.en: Designs are available in a myriad of colours.
ex.cn: 各种色彩的款式应有尽有。

senses.def: a sticky substance with a sweet smell that comes from trees and is used to make perfume and incense
senses.chn: 没药（芳香液状树脂，用于制香水等）

senses.def: a bush with shiny leaves, pink or white flowers and bluish-black berries
used when the speaker or writer is also the person affected by an action
senses.chn: （用于动作影响说话人或作者时）我自己

ex.en: I cut myself on a knife.
ex.cn: 我用刀时割伤了自己。

ex.en: I wrote a message to myself.
ex.cn: 我给自己留了个便条。

ex.en: I found myself unable to speak.
ex.cn: 我发现自己说不出话了。

ex.en: I haven't been feeling myself recently (= I have not felt well).
ex.cn: 我最近感觉不太好。

ex.en: I needed space to be myself (= not influenced by other people).
ex.cn: 我需要给自己留点儿空间。

senses.def: used to emphasize the fact that the speaker is doing sth
senses.chn: （强调说话者在做某事）我本人，亲自

ex.en: I'll speak to her myself.
ex.cn: 我要亲自去跟她说。

ex.en: I myself do not agree.
ex.cn: 我本人不同意。

senses.def: alone; without anyone else

ex.en: I live by myself.
ex.cn: 我自己一个人生活。

senses.def: without help

ex.en: I painted the room all by myself.
ex.cn: 我独自一人粉刷了屋子。

senses.def: for the speaker or writer alone; not shared

ex.en: I had a whole pizza to myself.
ex.cn: 我独自吃了一整个比萨饼。

senses.def: difficult to understand or explain; strange
senses.chn: 神秘的；奇怪的；不易解释的

ex.en: He died in mysterious circumstances.
ex.cn: 他的死因是个谜。

ex.en: A mysterious illness is affecting all the animals.
ex.cn: 一种奇怪的疾病正在侵袭所有的动物。

senses.def: strange and interesting because you do not know much about them

ex.en: A mysterious young woman is living next door.
ex.cn: 一位神秘的年轻女子住在隔壁。

senses.def: not saying much about sth, especially when other people want to know more

ex.en: He was being very mysterious about where he was going.
ex.cn: 他十分诡秘，闭口不谈他要去哪里。

senses.def: something that is difficult to understand or to explain
senses.chn: 神秘的事物；不可理解之事；奥秘

ex.en: It is one of the great unsolved mysteries of this century.
ex.cn: 这是本世纪尚未解开的大奥秘之一。

ex.en: Their motives remain a mystery.
ex.cn: 他们的动机仍然是个谜。

ex.en: It's a complete mystery to me why they chose him.
ex.cn: 我真无法理解他们为什么会选他。

senses.def: a person or thing that is strange and interesting because you do not know much about them or it
senses.chn: 神秘的人（或事物）；陌生而有趣的人（或事物）

ex.en: He's a bit of a mystery.
ex.cn: 他这个人有点儿神秘。

ex.en: There was a mystery guest on the programme.
ex.cn: 节目中有位神秘嘉宾。

ex.en: The band was financed by a mystery backer.
ex.cn: 这个乐队是由一个神秘人资助的。

ex.en: a mystery tour (= when you do not know where you are going)
ex.cn: 神秘之旅

senses.def: the quality of being difficult to understand or to explain, especially when this makes sb/sth seem interesting and exciting

ex.en: Mystery surrounds her disappearance.
ex.cn: 她的失踪引起了重重疑团。

ex.en: His past is shrouded in mystery (= not much is known about it).
ex.cn: 他来历不明。

ex.en: The dark glasses give her an air of mystery.
ex.cn: 这墨镜使她显得有些神秘。

senses.def: a story, a film/movie or a play in which crimes and strange events are only explained at the end

ex.en: I enjoy murder mysteries.
ex.cn: 我喜欢凶杀悬疑作品。

senses.def: secret religious ceremonies; secret knowledge
senses.chn: 秘密的宗教仪式；秘密知识

ex.en: the teacher who initiated me into the mysteries of mathematics
ex.cn: 把我引进神秘的数学世界的老师

senses.def: a religious belief that cannot be explained or proved in a scientific way

ex.en: the mystery of creation
ex.cn: 造物的奥秘

senses.def: a type of play that was popular between the 11th and 14th centuries and was based on events in the Bible or the lives of the Christian saints
senses.chn: 奥迹剧，神秘剧（11 到 14 世纪间流行的一种宗教剧，以《圣经》故事或基督教圣徒的生活为素材）

senses.def: a person whose job is to visit or telephone a shop/store or other business pretending to be a customer, in order to get information on the quality of the service, the facilities, etc.
senses.chn: 神秘顾客（受雇假扮成顾客去了解服务质量等的人）

senses.def: a person who tries to become united with God through prayer and meditation and so understand important things that are beyond normal human understanding
having spiritual powers or qualities that are difficult to understand or to explain
senses.chn: 神秘的；不可思议的；难以解释的

ex.en: mystical forces/powers
ex.cn: 神秘的力量／能力

ex.en: mystic beauty
ex.cn: 不可思议的美丽

ex.en: Watching the sun rise over the mountain was an almost mystical experience.
ex.cn: 看着太阳爬上山冈，这几乎是一种难以言传的体验。

senses.def: connected with mysticism

ex.en: the mystical life
ex.cn: 潜修生活

senses.def: the belief that knowledge of God and of real truth can be found through prayer and meditation rather than through reason and the senses

ex.en: Eastern mysticism
ex.cn: 东方神秘主义

senses.def: to make sb confused because they do not understand sth
senses.chn: 迷惑；使迷惑不解；使糊涂

ex.en: They were totally mystified by the girl's disappearance.
ex.cn: 那女孩失踪使他们大惑不解。

senses.def: the quality of being mysterious or secret that makes sb/sth seem interesting or attractive

ex.en: The mystique surrounding the monarchy has gone for ever.
ex.cn: 王室的神秘性已不复存在了。

senses.def: a story from ancient times, especially one that was told to explain natural events or to describe the early history of a people; this type of story

ex.en: ancient Greek myths
ex.cn: 古希腊神话

ex.en: a creation myth (= that explains how the world began)
ex.cn: 创世的神话

ex.en: the heroes of myth and legend
ex.cn: 神话和传说中的英雄

senses.def: something that many people believe but that does not exist or is false
senses.chn: 虚构的东西；荒诞的说法；不真实的事

ex.en: It is time to dispel the myth of a classless society (= to show that it does not exist).
ex.cn: 该消除那种无阶级社会的神话了。

ex.en: Contrary to popular myth, women are not worse drivers than men.
ex.cn: 都说女人开车比男人差，其实不然。

senses.def: that has become very famous, like sb/sth in a myth

ex.en: Scott of the Antarctic was a national hero of mythic proportions.
ex.cn: 南极探险家斯科特是位赫赫有名的民族英雄。

senses.def: existing only in ancient myths

ex.en: mythical beasts/heroes
ex.cn: 神话里的野兽／英雄

senses.def: that does not exist or is not true
senses.chn: 并不存在的；虚无的；不真实的

ex.en: the mythical 'rich uncle' that he boasts about
ex.cn: 他所吹嘘而并不存在的 “富伯”

senses.def: connected with ancient myths

ex.en: mythological subjects/figures/stories
ex.cn: 神话题材／人物／故事

senses.def: ancient myths in general; the ancient myths of a particular culture, society, etc.
senses.chn: （统称）神话；某文化（或社会等）的神话

ex.en: Greek mythology
ex.cn: 希腊神话

ex.en: a study of the religions and mythologies of ancient Rome
ex.cn: 关于古罗马的宗教和神话的研究

senses.def: ideas that many people think are true but that do not exist or are false
senses.chn: 虚幻的想法；错误的观点

ex.en: the popular mythology that life begins at forty
ex.cn: 生活四十方起步这种普遍的错误观点

senses.def: used to say that sb else has either to agree with your opinion or to leave
an infectious disease of rabbits that usually causes death
senses.chn: 兔黏液瘤病；多发黏液瘤病

senses.def: a person who is respected because of their age, experience or authority; an elder
senses.chn: （因年长、阅历丰富或有权力而）受尊敬的人；老人；长者；权威人士

senses.def: a title for a man that shows respect

ex.en: Mzee Kenyatta
ex.cn: 肯雅塔大人

senses.def: a white person with European family origins

ex.en: He was the only mzungu there.
ex.cn: 他是那里唯一的欧裔白人。

senses.def: connected with white European family origins
